task_title: Persist generated equipment through save/load and Floor 2 carryover

plan_review.notes: Initial review rejected missing production run identity, B3-capable generated equip, sourced grant ownership, static equipped migration, concrete reward-bundle ownership, and production-path coverage. Revised plan adopted all six: deterministic run-key plumbing, extension of B2 equipFromBag, explicit source maps with retained ownership, static plus generated equipped lanes, reference-only world bundle map, and real Floor 1 clear to Floor 2 configure integration.
